Work on a branch in /root/.openclaw/workspace/projects/gfvgo; run git status first.
Never edit /var/www/gfvgo directly; deploy only via deploy/deploy.sh.
Do not patch, deploy, or overwrite cms.gfvgo.com WordPress files from this repo.
